text.en:
The Municipality of Compostela shall have its present
territory minus the portions thereof which are ineluded
in the territory of the municipality of New Bataan as
delimited above.
The creation of this new municipality as proposed in
House Bill No. 14652 was approved by the House of
Representatives.
The municipality of New Bataan shall begin to exist
upon the appointment and qualification of the Mayor,
Vice-Mayor and a majority of the councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd clay of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-
